name: ds-utils-transformers
description: Scikit-learn pipeline transformers for multi-label binarization and sentence embeddings. Use for integrating MultiLabelBinarizer and sentence-transformers into sklearn Pipeline, ColumnTransformer, and set_output(transform="pandas"). Do NOT use for basic univariate feature plotting or correlation dendrograms.
